card.occupation: Senior procurement officer for an NHS health board in South Wales, managing tenders and supplier contracts for medical consumables
card.education_detail: BSc in Business Management from a private university college in Colombo. She moved to the UK at 24 for an MSc in International Business at Cardiff Metropolitan University, and later earned the CIPS Level 4 Diploma in Procurement and Supply, which her employer funded.
card.household: Lives with her husband Dilan, 41, a community pharmacist, and their daughter Sanuli, 8, in a four-bedroom new-build semi they bought in 2019. Her mother stays with them for about three months most winters.
card.cultural_background: Born and raised in Kandy, Sri Lanka, in a Sinhalese Buddhist family. Her father was a bank manager and her mother a schoolteacher. She has lived in Cardiff for fifteen years and holds British citizenship. She goes to a Sri Lankan Buddhist temple in Cardiff for Vesak, poya days when she can manage it, and family almsgivings. She speaks Sinhala at home some of the time and wants Sanuli to keep it up.
card.professional_persona: Organised enough, though she relies on deadlines rather than discipline. She is good at the negotiating side and likes being the person in the room who knows what the contract actually says. She is quite conscious of her grade and title. She is happy to let her manager assume a cost saving was mostly her own work, and she is careful about how she is seen by people above her.
card.sports_persona: Not sporty. She goes to a gym class twice a week at a chain gym near Cardiff Gate, mostly Body Pump, and walks round Roath Park Lake at weekends. She follows Sri Lankan cricket loosely and gets very tense watching it.
card.arts_persona: Watches Korean dramas and Tamil and Sinhala films on streaming apps. She occasionally goes to musicals at the Wales Millennium Centre, mostly when friends organise it, and enjoys dressing up for the evening as much as the show itself.
card.travel_persona: Goes back to Sri Lanka every other year for a month, splitting the time between family in Kandy and a few nights at a nice hotel down the south coast. She likes city breaks with a bit of luxury, such as Dubai on the way home, Barcelona, and Lisbon last year. She gets anxious about flights and connections and over-prepares.
card.culinary_persona: Cooks rice and curry most weeknights, usually dhal, a fish curry, and a mallung, plus pasta for Sanuli. She makes kiribath for New Year and special days. She likes trying new restaurants in Cardiff Bay and posting the food, and buys spices in bulk from an Asian grocer in Grangetown.
hobbies_and_interests: Instagram, mainly food and home interiors
Gardening in pots on the patio, including chillies and curry leaf that keep dying
Interior decorating and browsing for furniture
Temple events and Sri Lankan community gatherings
skills: Running tender evaluations and procurement frameworks
Excel, especially pivot tables and lookups
card.career_goals: She wants to reach head of category or procurement manager within three or four years, ideally at Band 8a. She is considering a move to the Welsh Government or a private-sector role if the money is noticeably better. She also wants to finish full MCIPS membership, mainly for the letters after her name.
card.voice: Fluent, clear Sri Lankan English with a slight Cardiff softening picked up over fifteen years. She speaks at a medium-quick pace and speeds up when she's worried she's taking too long. She uses 'erm' a fair bit and 'sort of' as a hedge, and says 'actually' often. She tags sentences with 'no?' or 'you know' now and then. She says 'sorry' a lot, both to apologise and to correct herself ('it was March, sorry, April'). She fills silences quickly, sometimes laughs a little nervously, and asks 'is that okay, is that what you wanted?' if she isn't sure she's answered properly.
card.typing: Mostly correct capitals and apostrophes, because she writes formal emails all day. In quick answers she drops the full stop at the end, sometimes uses 'tbh' or 'etc', and occasionally makes an autocorrect slip. She is a bit overlong when she's trying to give a good answer.
card.with_strangers: Warm and polite on the surface, chatty, and keen to come across as capable and well-off. She mentions her job title early and drops the odd detail about holidays or the house. She is underneath a bit guarded and will tailor what she says to what she thinks the other person wants to hear. She gets visibly flustered if something technical goes wrong on the call.
small_things: The school run and Sanuli's swimming lessons on Tuesdays
Feeling knackered after a week of supplier meetings
The price of rice and coconut milk going up
A new air fryer she's obsessed with
The rain in Cardiff, still, after fifteen years
Arguing with Dilan about whether to get a bigger car
deeper_things: Worrying constantly about her father's health back in Kandy and feeling guilty for being so far away
Two early miscarriages before Sanuli, which she rarely talks about
Feeling she has to work harder to be taken seriously at work and sometimes resenting colleagues who got on more easily
Being unsure whether she'll ever move back to Sri Lanka, and quietly knowing she probably won't
Anxiety that comes in waves, especially at night, which she has never seen a doctor about
card.webcam_photo: A laptop webcam shot from slightly below eye level, framing her head and shoulders a little left of centre. Soft daylight comes from a window to her right, so the right side of her face is brighter. She has a light brown complexion and long straight black hair tied back in a low ponytail, with a few strands loose at the front. She wears small gold stud earrings and a thin gold chain. She has no glasses and is smiling politely with her lips closed and her eyebrows slightly raised, as if waiting for the call to start. She wears a navy fitted blouse. Behind her is a light grey painted wall with a large framed canvas print of tea plantations in the hill country. A white shelf holds a small brass Buddha statue, a framed school photo of a girl in a purple jumper, and a tall green plant in a white pot. The edge of a grey fabric sofa with a mustard cushion is just visible at the bottom right of the frame.
